title: Contact maturity extension - mesh, path and failure robustness

scope.driver: common nonlinear residual and tangent assembly

requirements.name: Mesh and penalty sensitivity
requirements.evidence: At least three controlled mesh levels and the Lot 1 penalty values 1e4, 1e5 and 1e6.
requirements.policy: Keep geometry, total load and boundary conditions fixed; report penetration, reaction, displacement, active set, residual, iterations and determinism without a universal penalty range.

requirements.name: Contact load-path cycles
requirements.evidence: Open/close, close/open, open/close/open, reclose and load up/down paths.
requirements.policy: Record signed gap and active set at every accepted step; inactive contact must not create attraction and final replay must be deterministic.

requirements.name: Contact-compatible cutback and rollback
requirements.evidence: Controlled rejected increments before the first commit and after one committed increment, with retry and reference comparison.
requirements.policy: Rollback must preserve committed material state and displacement; contact state is stateless and is recomputed from the trial geometry.

requirements.name: Adversarial failure contract
requirements.evidence: Invalid penalty, invalid target/geometry, unsupported route, excessive penetration and Newton non-convergence.
requirements.policy: Expected failures are fail-closed, typed or reason-coded, finite, deterministic and never reported as converged.

requirements.name: Penalty candidate governance
requirements.evidence: Candidate interval is derived from Lot 1 and Lot 2 observations and remains explicitly Owner-reviewable.
requirements.policy: No production penalty interval or conditioning cutoff is approved by the campaign.

failure_policy.state_preservation: contact active set is stateless; material/displacement transaction must be checked where the common driver is exercised
